inlines.v: VOUCHSAFE, verb intransitive [vouch and safe; to vouch or answer for safety.] 1. To permit to be done without danger. 2. To condescend to grant. Shall I vouchsafe your worship a word or two? It is not said by the apostle that God vouchsafed to the heathen the means of salvation. VOUCHSAFE, verb intransitive To condescend; to deign; to yield. VOUCHSAFE, illustrious Ormond, to behold What powr the charms of beauty had of old.
